patch_summary: v641 with sign released. v641 clamped each code to its deployed sign's side of the range, so it could not cross zero; sign is a returned parameter, so the legal set is the whole +-1.75*unit interval. Rewriting sign with mant reaches the remainder of the identity optimum that the probe's symmetric-clamp oracle already counted (the gap between v641's 92% capture and 100%).
